decisions.title: Storage
decisions.decision: Single Storm v3.2.1/bbolt v1.3.4 service-owned backend for local and remote; one process/data directory, per-project DB, whole-mutation revision/audit transactions; no client FS backend or SQL rewrite.

decisions.title: Lifecycle
decisions.decision: Explicit canonical task facts; done/closed satisfy dependencies, remove integrating-checkpoint/CR authority; preserve estimate/assignee/hierarchy guards, manual container statuses and terminal-ancestor invariant.

decisions.title: Planning
decisions.decision: Retain leaf DAG, projected advisory containers, scope/set/children/related/active, Kahn waves and unweighted path; deterministic lexical ties; diagnostic unusable plans never hide problems.

decisions.title: API and import
decisions.decision: Freeze root contract v1 exact route/DSL/field/native snapshot allowlists; legacy-v2 sanitized import adapter, bounded validation and atomic empty-project commit; no arbitrary legacy registration.

decisions.title: Concurrency and trust
decisions.decision: Strong revision CAS and all facts/audit in one transaction; explicit narrow projection/credential/authorizer seams, synthetic local adapter now, production adapter adoption held; fail closed with no credentials/scope; no ambient identity/network listener.

decisions.title: Kernel local identity, remoteTLS, task journal and read-only rollback
decisions.decision: contract.md D6 overrides earlier production transport/Bearer language. HTTP remains synthetic. No new shared Go interfaces. Journal v2 disposition and external signer/Host/U1 remain gated.

counterproposals.resolution: Inject exact local interfaces and synthetic adapter now; hold production adoption, do not invent an upstream API or serialize all producers behind it.
One baseline followed by four independent producer packets; one integration packet; shared files have a single owner.
Explicit synthetic offline provisioning only; auth production provisioning remains held.
Explicit confirm=true leaf-only deletion; incoming references refuse, no implicit subtree deletion.
Computed phases, one native schema, explicit future migration only when required; no framework or schedule objects.
Preserve safe references; unsupported required binary/local resources block real import, no silent loss or speculative MinIO dependency.

holds.U1: Production configurator/auth adapter needs owning source pin and accepted contract; synthetic implementation unblocked.
holds.destination: Orchestrator supplies private relux-works/swarma-board repository and base; architect does not create/publish.
holds.real_data: Owner-authorized sanitized snapshot/digest/mapping/custody/resources required before real adoption.
holds.landing: Independent Muse muse-wonder-full-1.0-contributor xhigh review, required checks and authorized signed owner landing.
holds.cutover: Separate source-owner writer switch/remote deployment authorization.
holds.Host: Protected UID mapping/grants, distinct UIDs and runtime/socket service contract required.
holds.audit_schema: Existing v1 lacks digest/version/project; explicit v2/new-project disposition required before persistent change.
holds.signer: External custodian/key/trust anchor/algorithm/custody required; bot signing key never inferred.
holds.rollback: Fresh post-cutover checkpoint read-only; old writer separately reconciled/authorized.
